# Related Backblaze B2 sample applications

The [`backblaze-b2-samples`](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples) organization, also indexed on [Backblaze Labs](https://backblazelabs.com/), contains practical applications that complement these reference architectures. The projects below demonstrate specific capture, reconstruction, map and 3D delivery, inspection and dataset patterns.

## Closest workflow matches

<!-- catalog:samples-workflow:start -->
| Sample | What it demonstrates | Most relevant here |
|---|---|---|
| [OpenDroneMap Photogrammetry Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/opendronemap-photogrammetry-pipeline) | Drone photos upload by presigned PUT into mission prefixes, a local NodeODM engine reconstructs them, and the orthomosaic, DEM, point cloud and mesh return to B2 with managed multipart upload; JSON mission manifests replace a database. | [flight-capture-offload](../architectures/flight-capture-offload/architecture.md), [photogrammetry-processing](../architectures/photogrammetry-processing/architecture.md) |
| [YOLO Drone Footage Detection](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/yolo-drone-footage-detection) | Drone video streams to B2 by multipart upload; Ultralytics YOLO runs on sampled keyframes, detections are geotagged from GPX/SRT telemetry, and annotated frames, per-frame JSON and a GeoJSON track are written back. | [ai-inspection-detection](../architectures/ai-inspection-detection/architecture.md) |
| [TiTiler COG Map Tiles](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/titiler-cog-map-tiles) | GeoTIFFs are converted to COGs in B2 and TiTiler serves dynamic XYZ tiles through GDAL /vsis3/ range reads, so no tile pyramid is stored. | [cog-map-serving](../architectures/cog-map-serving/architecture.md) |
| [Roboflow Inference Frame Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/roboflow-inference-frame-archive) | Roboflow Inference runs locally and archives only flagged frames and prediction JSON to B2 with Parquet roll-ups; built around cameras, the same pattern fits a ground station or dock computer. | [ai-inspection-detection](../architectures/ai-inspection-detection/architecture.md) |
| [YOLO11 Batch Detection Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/yolo11-batch-detection-pipeline) | Batch detection and segmentation runs over an image and video library in B2 and writes COCO JSON, annotated frames and crops back; used here for model-version reprocessing. | [ai-inspection-detection](../architectures/ai-inspection-detection/architecture.md) |
| [Open3D Point Cloud Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/open3d-point-cloud-pipeline) | Point cloud scans are ingested, downsampled, registered and meshed, with artifacts and a job manifest written to B2; it complements PDAL and does not replace COPC/EPT conversion. | [point-cloud-3d-streaming](../architectures/point-cloud-3d-streaming/architecture.md) |
| [COLMAP Photogrammetry Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/colmap-photogrammetry-archive) | pycolmap structure-from-motion archives photos, the COLMAP database, sparse model and point cloud per project on B2 and serves them by presigned URL. | [photogrammetry-processing](../architectures/photogrammetry-processing/architecture.md) |
| [COLMAP Gaussian Splatting Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/colmap-gaussian-splatting-pipeline) | Photos or video become a COLMAP reconstruction and a Nerfstudio/gsplat-ready bundle versioned on B2, a pattern for site digital twins. | [point-cloud-3d-streaming](../architectures/point-cloud-3d-streaming/architecture.md) |
<!-- catalog:samples-workflow:end -->

## Operational building blocks

<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:start -->
| Sample | Reusable pattern |
|---|---|
| [SAM 2 Mask Dataset Builder](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/sam2-mask-dataset-builder) | A raw image and video archive on B2 becomes a versioned segmentation dataset using local SAM 2, useful for pre-labeling defect masks. |
| [fastdup Dataset Cleaning](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/fastdup-dataset-cleaning) | Finds exact and near duplicates, outliers and corrupt files in B2 image datasets, writes quality reports, and quarantines flagged files without deleting originals. |
| [DuckDB Query In Place](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/duckdb-query-in-place) | DuckDB httpfs pointed at the B2 endpoint queries Parquet, CSV and JSON in place and materializes result slices back to B2 as Parquet. |
| [B2 Event Broker](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-event-broker) | Validates signed B2 Event Notifications and fans them out to subscribers; this is where filtering for the manifest key happens, because B2 rules filter by prefix only. |
| [cloudflare-b2 (private bucket via Worker)](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/cloudflare-b2) | A Worker signs requests to a private B2 bucket and passes range requests through, for CDN delivery of COGs and 3D tilesets without a public bucket. |
| [B2 Browser Upload](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-browser-upload) | Browser-direct upload to B2 by S3 presigned PUT or b2_upload_file with keys held server-side; single uploads are capped at 5 GB, so it fits field portals for stills while video needs multipart. |
<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:end -->

- [IfcOpenShell BIM Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/ifcopenshell-bim-archive): IFC models, meshes and reports are archived per project with manifests and served by presigned URL; pairs with construction survey twins for progress comparison.

## Selection guidance

- Select a sample based on the required workflow and data formats.
- Keep key scoping, retention and evidence decisions in this repository's architecture documents.
- Several samples are built for general cameras or satellite imagery. Their B2 patterns transfer to drone data; their models and parsers may not.
- Configure authentication, tenant isolation, scoped credentials, retention, and recovery for the deployment.
